q.en: You are tickling your friend. She says, 'Stop, I don't like it.' What do you do?
q.hg: Tum apni friend ko gudgudi kar rahe ho. Woh bolti hai, 'Ruko, mujhe yeh pasand nahi.' Tum kya karoge?

options.en: Stop right away
options.hg: Turant ruk jaoge

options.en: Tickle a little more because she is laughing
options.hg: Thodi aur gudgudi karoge kyunki woh hans rahi hai

options.en: Tell her not to be a spoilsport
options.hg: Use bologe ki game kharab mat karo

explain.en: Stop means stop, even if someone is laughing. Listening to her no makes you a good friend.
explain.hg: Ruko ka matlab ruko hai, chahe koi hans hi kyun na raha ho. Uski 'no' sunna tumhe achha dost banata hai.

q.en: Which of these is an 'I' sentence?
q.hg: Inme se 'main' wala sentence kaun-sa hai?

options.en: 'You are so selfish.'
options.hg: 'Tu kitna selfish hai.'

options.en: 'You never wait for me.'
options.hg: 'Tu kabhi mera wait nahi karta.'

options.en: 'Everyone thinks you are rude.'
options.hg: 'Sabko lagta hai tu rude hai.'

options.en: 'I feel left out when you go without me. Please wait for me.'
options.hg: 'Jab tum mere bina chale jaate ho toh mujhe left out feel hota hai. Please mera wait karna.'

explain.en: It names your feeling, the situation and what you need, without attacking the other person.
explain.hg: Isme tumhari feeling, situation aur tumhari need batayi gayi hai, aur saamne wale pe koi attack nahi hai.

q.en: A message says, 'Decide right now, this offer disappears in ten minutes, and don't tell anyone.' Which two tactics are being used?
q.hg: Ek message mein likha hai, 'Abhi decide karo, yeh offer das minute mein khatam ho jayega, aur kisi ko mat batana.' Isme kaun-si do tactics use ho rahi hain?

options.en: Flattery and guilt
options.hg: Flattery aur guilt

options.en: Rushing and secrecy
options.hg: Rushing aur secrecy

options.en: Honest asking and patience
options.hg: Honest asking aur patience

options.en: Gaslighting and bandwagon
options.hg: Gaslighting aur bandwagon

explain.en: A deadline stops you from thinking, and secrecy stops you from asking anyone. Honest offers survive both time and a second opinion.
explain.hg: Deadline tumhe sochne se rokti hai, aur secrecy kisi se poochne se. Honest offers time aur second opinion, dono ke saamne tike rehte hain.

q.en: You type your symptoms into a search engine or an AI chatbot and it suggests a serious disease. What is the most sensible next step?
q.hg: Tum apne symptoms search engine ya AI chatbot mein type karte ho aur woh koi serious disease suggest kar deta hai. Sabse sensible next step kya hai?

options.en: Accept it as your diagnosis and order medicines online
options.hg: Isse apna diagnosis maan lo aur online medicines order kar lo

options.en: Ignore your symptoms completely because the internet is always wrong
options.hg: Apne symptoms ko completely ignore kar do kyunki internet hamesha galat hota hai

options.en: Treat it as a starting point, note your symptoms and ask a doctor
options.hg: Isse bas starting point samjho, apne symptoms note kar lo aur doctor se poocho

options.en: Ask a friend which tablets worked for them
options.hg: Kisi dost se poocho ki use kaun-si tablets se aaram mila tha

explain.en: Online tools cannot examine you, and the same symptoms can have many causes. They are useful for preparing questions, not for diagnosis or treatment.
explain.hg: Online tools tumhe examine nahi kar sakte, aur same symptoms ke kai causes ho sakte hain. Woh sawaal ready karne ke kaam aate hain, diagnosis ya treatment ke nahi.

q.en: Which preparation helps a doctor's appointment the most?
q.hg: Doctor ke appointment se pehle kaun-si taiyaari sabse zyada kaam aati hai?

options.en: Writing down your symptoms, when they started, your medicines and your questions
options.hg: Apne symptoms, woh kab shuru hue, apni medicines aur apne sawaal likh lena

options.en: Deciding in advance which medicine you want prescribed
options.hg: Pehle se decide kar lena ki tumhe kaun-si medicine likhwani hai

options.en: Leaving out the embarrassing details to save time
options.hg: Time bachane ke liye embarrassing details chhod dena

options.en: Stopping all your regular medicines the day before
options.hg: Ek din pehle apni saari regular medicines band kar dena

explain.en: A clear, complete history is what leads to the right tests and treatment. Never stop or change regular medicines without medical advice.
explain.hg: Clear aur complete history se hi sahi tests aur sahi treatment tak pahuncha jata hai. Medical advice ke bina regular medicines kabhi band ya change mat karo.

q.en: Someone posts in your class group: 'Heard Neha has some disease, stay away from her.' There is no proof. What is the responsible thing to do?
q.hg: Koi tumhari class ke group mein post karta hai: 'Suna hai Neha ko koi bimaari hai, usse door raho.' Koi proof nahi hai. Responsible cheez kya hogi?

options.en: Forward it to other groups so that everyone can be careful
options.hg: Isse doosre groups mein forward kar do taaki sab careful rahein

options.en: React with a laughing emoji and stay out of it
options.hg: Laughing emoji bhejo aur isse door raho

options.en: Ask Neha in the group whether it is true
options.hg: Group mein hi Neha se poocho ki kya yeh sach hai

options.en: Not forward it, say in the group that an unverified rumour about someone's health is not okay, and check on Neha privately
options.hg: Isse forward mat karo, group mein bolo ki kisi ki health ke baare mein unverified rumour theek nahi hai, aur Neha se privately haal poocho

explain.en: A rumour needs people to pass it on, so not forwarding it, calling it out and supporting Neha privately stops the harm without exposing her further. Even if it were true, a person's health is private and is no reason to avoid them.
explain.hg: Rumour ko aage badhane wale log chahiye hote hain, isliye use forward na karna, use call out karna aur Neha ko privately support karna, use aur expose kiye bina harm rokta hai. Agar baat sach bhi ho, toh kisi ki health uski private baat hai aur usse door rehne ki koi wajah nahi hai.
